channel.title: NIDO Research Institute - Publications & Case Studies
channel.description: Empirical early childhood research, authentic AMI Montessori case studies, and naturalistic observation datasets from Nido Montessori Preschool (Bachupally) & Blue Blocks School (Hyderabad).

item.title: Building a Montessori School from the Ground Up: An Observational Case Study of the Founding Phases of Nido Montessori Preschool, Bachupally
item.description: A 30-page observational case study documenting the six founding phases, mixed-age normalization dynamics, executive function metrics, and prepared environment design at Nido Montessori Preschool Bachupally.
item.author: Shobha Goyal

item.title: The Architecture of Attention: Three-Hour Work Cycles and Executive Function in Early Childhood
item.description: Quantitative and qualitative tracking of sustained concentration, task persistence, and deep flow states during uninterrupted three-hour work cycles in 3-6 primary Montessori environments.
item.author: NIDO Research Team

item.title: Mathematical Intuition Through Sensorial Materials: From Concrete Manipulation to Abstract Reasoning
item.description: Longitudinal tracking of mathematical schemas comparing traditional didactic arithmetic instruction with tactile Montessori Golden Beads, Bead Stair, and Stamp Game apparatus.
item.author: NIDO Research Team

item.title: Language Emergence in the Prepared Infant-Toddler Environment: A Naturalistic Observation Study
item.description: Acoustic mapping and phonological emergence tracking in infant-toddler environments comparing adult-directed linguistic environments with Montessori classified vocabulary cards and natural speech.
item.author: NIDO Research Team
